agentids.description: AgentIDs contains the ids of the unknown agents

authorized.description:
Authorized, If not null, is the new value indicating whether the
agent is to be considered authorized. If this is omitted from the
JSON object, it is considered to be null.

config.description:
Config, if not null, is new value of the scan-agent specific
configuration. Note that it replaces the If this is omitted from
the JSON object, it is considered to be null.

heartbeat_timeout.description:
HeartbeatTimeout, if not, null is the new value of the
HeartbeatTimeout in seconds. If this is omitted from the JSON
object, it is considered to be null.

min_interval.description:
MinInterval, if not null, is the new value of the MinInterval in
seconds. If this is omitted from the JSON object, it is
considered to be null.

update_to_latest.description:
UpdateToLatest, if not null, is the new value indicating whether
the agent should automatically update to the latest version.
If this is omitted from the JSON object, it is considered to be null.

agentid.description: AgentID is the id of the scan-agent

authorized.description:
Authorized indicates whether the scan agent has been authorized
to deliver scan results

config.description:
Config is the scan-agent specific configuration that is sent to
the scan-agent.

connection_status.description:
ConnectionStatus indicates the status of scan-agent. See the
ConnectionStatus type for details

hostname.description:
Hostname is the name of the host the scan-agent runs on as
reported by the scan-agent itself.

ip_addresses.description:
IPAddresses contains all the IP addresses of the host the
scan-agent runs on as reported by the scan-agent itself.

os_cpe.description:
OSCpe is the full CPE 2.3 string of the host OS as reported by the
scan-agent-updater (e.g. cpe:2.3:o:redhat:enterprise_linux:9.2:-:-:-:-:-:x86_64:-).
Empty string means the agent has not yet reported one (e.g. an older updater).

os_status.description:
OSStatus is "supported", "unsupported", or "unknown" based on the
agent's OSCpe matched against the supported-OS list.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is time of the log output.

agentid.description: AgentID is the id of the scan-agent

last_update.description: LastUpdate is the time when the SBOM data was updated.

sbom.description: SBOM contains the raw SBOM data.

scan_result_status.description:
ScanResultStatus is the processing status of the SBOM ("none", "success"
or "unprocessable"). Populated by the support-bundle lookup.

sent_to_skiron.description:
SentToSkiron is when the SBOM was forwarded to Skiron, if at all.
Populated by the support-bundle lookup.

agentid.description: AgentID is the id of the scanagent

source.description: Source is the source of the log entry

timestamp.description: Timestamp is time of the log output.

extra.description:
Extra is a set of key/value pairs the agent provides when
registering that can be used to identify its host and help decide
whether to authorize it.

token.description:
Token is the value of the bearer token used by the scan-agent to
authenticate API requests after having registered.
